name: toy-60-r1
cmd: nproc; GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 300 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only toy_consensus_forall --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'join (enumerated|end)|\[infer\] (start|runs|kernel|end)|\[infer join\]' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-200 | tail -c 30000; times; exit $s
